title: Adaptive control with convex saturation constraints
abstract: This paper applies retrospective cost adaptive control (RCAC) to command following in the presence of multivariable convex input saturation constraints. To account for the satu-ration constraint, we use convex optimization to minimize the quadratic retrospective cost function. The use of convex opti-mization bounds the magnitude of the retrospectively optimized input and thereby influences the controller update to satisfy the control bounds. This technique is applied to a tiltrotor with con-straints on the total thrust magnitude and inclination of the rotor plan. Copyright © 2013 by ASME.
